critical_code_review_comments: routes/donations.py /donations/mine returns full donation docs including pan_number/aadhaar_number/address. Acceptable since the caller is the donor, but consider redacting Aadhaar in the API response (frontend doesn't display it) to reduce blast radius if a token is leaked.

routes/admin.py CSV export functions stream via iter([buf.getvalue()]) which buffers entire CSV in memory. With to_list(20000) for donations and to_list(50000) for activity, peak memory could spike when row counts grow. Consider true streaming with csv.writer and yielding chunks, plus pagination for >50k rows.

routes/admin.py export_roster_csv joins specializations and badges with ', ' which is the same character class as CSV column separator only via comma; csv.DictWriter properly quotes fields so this is safe, but worth a code comment to prevent future 'cleanup' from breaking it.

routes/admin.py log_activity is awaited synchronously inside each export endpoint AFTER fetch but BEFORE the StreamingResponse returns — fine for correctness but adds a write to a hot path. Consider fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task to keep export latency tight.

Profile.js fee-breakdown uses U+00B7 middle dot as separator; rendered correctly. Make sure screen readers don't read it weirdly — consider aria-label='Pledged X rupees plus Y rupees fees, total Z rupees' for accessibility.
Dashboard.js handleExportCsv catches errors but does not differentiate 401 vs 5xx; user just sees 'Failed to export'. Acceptable for v1.
